title: Assistant Manager - Business Finance | CA pass -out 2026
description:
About the Team
The BizFin team at Meesho is a close-knit and high-performing team comprising professionals from Big 4 consulting firms, FMCG companies, and leading investment firms. The team includes Chartered Accountants, business specialists, and former investment bankers, each bringing diverse expertise and perspectives to the table.
The team focuses on solving complex and high-impact business problems across Meesho’s ecosystem. From driving growth strategies to improving financial operations, BizFin plays a crucial role in influencing key business decisions and contributing to the company’s success.
The team also emphasizes cross-functional exposure, enabling members to work across multiple business areas and gain broader learning opportunities. At its core, the team values excellence, collaboration, and strong team relationships, fostering a culture that celebrates both individual growth and collective impact.
About the Role
As AM - Finance, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust financial plans and ensuring effective execution. You will play a key role in driving financial planning, budgeting, and analysis to support evolving business requirements.
You will also be expected to adapt financial plans and budgets in line with changing business strategies and priorities. On a day-to-day basis, the role involves providing financial support and strategic advice to management while assisting in closing business deals.
This role offers an opportunity to work on impactful finance-related challenges at one of India’s leading e-commerce platforms, contributing to initiatives that affect millions of users across the country.

title: Finance Associate
description:
About Bureau 
 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 Why Bureau? 
 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 About the Role - Finance Associate 
 Behind every fast-growing company is a finance engine that runs like clockwork, and that's where you come in.
 As our Finance Associate , you'll keep the books sharp, the numbers honest and every Bureau employee paid right and on time. To be clear up front: payroll is a core expectation of this role, and you'll own it end to end. But it's not a payroll-only job. You'll get a real blend of finance work too, from vendor payments and reconciliations to month-end close, compliance and audits, so you grow as an all-round finance professional.
 What you’ll be doing 
 Payroll, end-to-end: run monthly payroll, handle inputs, full-and-final settlements, reimbursements and payslip queries so nobody ever worries about their salary.
 Statutory compliance: TDS, PF, ESI, PT and Form 16, filed accurately and on deadline.
 Day-to-day finance: vendor payments, invoicing, expense tracking and bank reconciliations.
 Month-end close: support book closing, accruals and MIS reports the leadership team actually relies on.
 Audits and controls: keep documentation audit-ready and help tighten processes as we scale.
 Automation: spot the manual, repetitive work and help us replace it with smarter tools.
 What You’ll Bring 
 To shine here, you should have:
 1-3 years of hands-on payroll experience, ideally with broader finance or accounting work alongside it.
 A B.Com , M.Com , MBA (Finance) or a CA Inter / similar qualification.
 Working knowledge of Indian payroll statutory compliance and Tally, Zoho or a similar accounting tool.
 Strong Excel skills, a sharp eye for detail and a love for numbers that add up.
 Discretion with confidential data and a calm, friendly way of answering "where's my salary?" questions.
 Bonus points for experience in a startup or fintech, or with HRMS and payroll platforms.
 Our Culture 
 We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
 We value performance, not hours worked
 Speed, ownership, and impact matter most
 Compensation 
 Competitive salary + potential equity
 Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget
